business_problem: Bank of America needed to serve a very large client and employee base with faster, always-available financial guidance and support, while reducing call-center and IT service desk load and making digital interactions more personalized and efficient.
solution_summary: Bank of America built Erica as an in-house, AI-driven virtual financial assistant embedded in its digital banking experience and then reused the same AI capabilities across other lines of business. The source describes Erica ingesting customer and enterprise context such as spending activity, balance trends, rewards eligibility, investment questions, transaction lookups, and employee support requests from Bank of America systems. Bank of America data scientists trained Erica to recognize and respond to millions of client questions, using a curated library of more than 700 responses and more than 75,000 updates since launch to improve answer quality over time. Erica serves proactive, personalized insights to consumer users, while related assistants extend the pattern into Merrill, CashPro, and employee support. The implementation includes seamless handoff from self-service conversations into appointments and higher-touch service channels, but the source does not name the underlying storage or infrastructure platforms.

solution_components.name: Erica
solution_components.role: AI-driven virtual financial assistant that answers client questions, delivers proactive financial insights, and routes users to appointments or higher-touch service when needed.

solution_components.name: ask MERRILL®
solution_components.role: AI assistant used by wealth management teams to curate information and help advisors engage clients on timely and relevant opportunities.

solution_components.name: CashPro® Chat
solution_components.role: Virtual service advisor for the CashPro platform that helps business, commercial, and corporate clients view transactions and find account information.

solution_components.name: Erica for Employees
solution_components.role: Internal virtual assistant that answers employee questions and reduces demand on the IT service desk.

data_flow: Bank of America feeds Erica and related assistants with banking and enterprise context including spending activity, balance trends, rewards eligibility, investment topics, transactions, account information, and employee support questions. The AI layer matches those inputs to trained responses and proactive insights, then serves answers through consumer banking, wealth, CashPro, and employee channels, with handoff to appointments or higher-touch service when needed.
integration_points: Bank of America IT service desk
business_outcome: Erica scaled digital self-service across consumer, wealth, commercial, and employee experiences, improving client experience, increasing personalization, and reducing pressure on call-center and IT support teams.
